name: Max Junestrand

education.school: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm
education.degree: MSc Computer Engineering / Computer Science (ML specialisation) — did not complete master's thesis
education.notes: Per the SSE alumni profile: studied Computer Engineering at KTH from 2018 in parallel with the SSE BSc. Did not complete his master's thesis at KTH (left to build Legora).
Double-degree alongside KTH. SSE affiliation became the trigger for founding Legora — SSE Business Lab required an SSE-affiliated founder, and the co-founders didn't have one, so Max joined them.
Reported across search-derived bios; exact dates not in the SSE profile. Likely an exchange / semester component of the KTH degree rather than a standalone master's.

keyDecisions: Took a full-time software engineering job in his early KTH years while continuing studies — a former competitive e-sports player going to work at an e-sports data company.
Optimised for shipping production code as a teenager / 20-year-old, not for grades.
lessons: Real shipping reps in your first programming job dwarf coursework — Junestrand was a working SWE before he was a founder.
Your hobbies (e-sports) can be your first employer — it cuts onboarding cost and gives you irrational motivation.
careerSteps.notes: Per LinkedIn-derived bios: Back End Engineer June–July 2020, then Software Engineer July 2020 – May 2021.

careerSteps.role: Stacked VC / Consulting / Startup Internships (the 'six roles in one year')
careerSteps.company: Norrsken VC, Norrsken Impact Accelerator, McKinsey & Company, Depict, Bemlo (YC W22)
keyDecisions: Stacked six roles in a single year across VC, consulting and YC startups: Norrsken (Investment Team Jan–Apr 2022), Depict (Growth, Mar–Apr 2022), McKinsey (Business Analyst Intern, Apr–Jun 2022), Bemlo / YC W22 (Growth, Jun–Jul 2022), Norrsken Impact Accelerator (Jul–Sep 2022), Norrsken VC (Visiting Analyst, Sep 2022 – Jan 2023).
Treated VC + accelerator exposure as a prerequisite, not a destination — Norrsken specifically was the gateway into the Swedish founder network.
Worked directly inside a YC-backed startup (Bemlo, W22) so the YC application playbook was a known quantity by the time Legora applied.
lessons: VC internships are a fast way to acquire pattern recognition for what wins in tech — and the network density that fundraises later.
European VC scenes are small enough that 1–2 stints (Norrsken in Sweden's case) materially open doors.
Working inside a YC company (Bemlo) before founding gives you the YC playbook from the inside — Legora applied with that asymmetric info.
Stacking roles in one year is a legitimate Swedish-student speedrun strategy when degrees are part-time / double-tracked.
careerSteps.notes: All six roles confirmed via LinkedIn-derived summaries; Norrsken Impact Week 2025 talk title is literally 'From Norrsken intern to unicorn founder in 2 years.' SSE alumni profile confirms 'six different roles in a single year.'

keyDecisions: Two friends approached Max with the idea; he joined as third co-founder because SSE Business Lab required an SSE-affiliated founder and Max was the only one with that affiliation — the credential literally created the team.
Got into SSE Business Lab as the launch ramp, then pushed the team to apply to Y Combinator (initially rejected, later accepted).
Picked legal AI — a vertical with clear willingness-to-pay and underserved by AI-native tools as of 2023.
Built in Stockholm rather than relocating to SF — proved frontier-AI startups don't require Silicon Valley HQ.
Shaped the product around feedback from working lawyers rather than founder intuition.
Raised aggressively from tier-1 investors: Index, Benchmark, ICONIQ — public reporting describes a 7-day fundraise with ~15 term sheets en route to choosing Benchmark.
lessons: Vertical AI (a specific profession) beats horizontal AI for early capture in the AI-revolution era.
Founding at 23 with VC-side experience > founding at 19 without it — Max literally needed two of the six roles above to credibly raise.
An academic affiliation can be a binding-constraint that creates the team (SSE Business Lab requirement).
Lawyer-in-the-loop product development outperforms pure founder instinct for regulated knowledge-work tools.
European legal-tech is a viable AI-revolution founding market — buyers are large, fragmented, and ready to pay; Legora reached a reported $5.55B valuation.
careerSteps.notes: Co-founders include Sigge Labor (CTO) and Anton Qvarfordt. Legora is an AI-native platform for legal professionals. Public reporting (Bessemer Atlas, Global Legal Post, 20VC) places it as the fastest enterprise business to reach $100M ARR; valuation reported at $5.55B as of 2025; Jude Law fronted a 2025 global brand campaign.

outcomes.currentStatus: Building Legora as CEO from Stockholm. Backed by Benchmark, Index, ICONIQ. Reported valuation $5.55B (2025). Paper wealth only — no liquidity event yet.

lessons.lesson: Earn the right to found by working on the capital/strategy side first — Norrsken VC twice, McKinsey, and inside a YC company, all before founding.
lessons.source: SSE alumni profile + Norrsken Impact Week 2025 talk title.

lessons.lesson: Vertical AI for specific professions captures faster than horizontal AI in 2023–2026.
lessons.source: Inferred from Legora's positioning and reported traction.

lessons.lesson: European legal-tech is a viable AI-revolution founding market.
lessons.source: Inferred from Legora's reported valuation trajectory.

lessons.lesson: Real users (lawyers) shaping the product beats founder-only intuition in regulated knowledge-work verticals.

lessons.lesson: An academic affiliation (SSE Business Lab requirement) can be the binding constraint that creates the team — a credential's most valuable use is sometimes the door it opens, not the knowledge inside.
Six-stacked-roles-in-a-year is a viable Swedish-student strategy when degrees are part-time / double-tracked.

notes: Most directly relevant role model for the AI-revolution era European-founder archetype. The structural story is now well verified: KTH Computer Engineering (2018–2023) + SSE Business & Economics (2020–2023, double-degree) → SWE at Abios (2020–2021) → six stacked roles in 2022 across Norrsken VC, McKinsey, Depict, Bemlo (YC W22), Norrsken Impact Accelerator → co-founded Legora in 2023 via the SSE Business Lab → YC → Benchmark / Index / ICONIQ → reported $5.55B valuation. This is the exact pattern Roan finds compelling.
